name: jid-globe
author: Alexander Garner (https://github.com/TheMrPuffin)
description: JOTA-JOTI JID codes as pins on a shared 3D globe

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api
scripts.test: npm test -w api && npm test -w web
